code='''def transform(grid):
    """Return the second panel, highlighting its color shared with the first panel."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The panels are equal-sized and separated by one solid row or column.
    if h % 2 == 1:
        r = h // 2
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            first, second = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            common = {v for row in first for v in row} & {v for row in second for v in row}
            target = next(iter(common)) if common else 0
            return [[3 if v == target else target for v in row] for row in second]
    if w % 2 == 1:
        c = w // 2
        if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid):
            first = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            second = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            common = {v for row in first for v in row} & {v for row in second for v in row}
            target = next(iter(common)) if common else 0
            return [[3 if v == target else target for v in row] for row in second]
    raise ValueError("no centered solid panel separator found")
'''
